title: contract.Spec cannot convert a #[contracterror] argument or a nested soroban_sdk::Error value

target.versions_affected: 17.4.0 and main 5243062f (the code involved is the same in both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: nativeToUdt has no case for scSpecEntryUdtErrorEnumV0 and the spec's scValToNative handles scSpecTypeError only in a Result's error slot, so funcArgsToScVals throws for a #[contracterror] argument (given the case number or a ready ScVal) and funcResToNative throws for a struct field of type Error; the contract Client and generated bindings cannot call such a function or read the value. These types are rare in deployed contracts (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: funcArgsToScVals encodes a #[contracterror] argument as scvError(sceContract(code)) and funcResToNative gives { type: "contract", code } for a nested Error value, the shape scValToNative already uses
entries.observed: No corpus entry converts an error value through a contract spec. By hand on 17.4.0: funcArgsToScVals('report', { e: 1 }) and funcArgsToScVals('report', { e: <ScVal> }) throw failed to parse udt MyError; funcResToNative('last', …) for a struct with an Error field throws failed to convert … to native type from type scSpecTypeError; the generic scValToNative gives {"type":"contract","code":1}.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's script on 17.4.0 (main 5243062f has the same code): both funcArgsToScVals calls throw failed to parse udt MyError and funcResToNative('last') throws failed to convert { "error": { "contract": 1 } } to native type from type scSpecTypeError.
evidence.expected_basis: soroban-sdk implements TryFromVal in both directions between a #[contracterror] enum and an scvError of type sceContract with the case's code, so a contract can take one as an argument, and maps soroban_sdk::Error to the spec type Error, which can be nested in a #[contracttype] struct or a Vec.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on 17.4.0 before filing on 2026-11-19: the #[contracterror] argument and the nested Error value both throw.

queries: stellar/js-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/js-stellar-sdk/issues/1915; this record restates the public issue.
